1.why: P1: ASCA hangers at top of pitch; single 60 m reaches ground
1.text: Bolted anchor with newer hangers at the top of the thin flake; one 60 m rope reaches the ground from it.

2.why: P2: bolted anchor at top, balancy slab just below
2.text: Bolted anchor just above the short balancy slab that ends the pitch.

3.why: P3: bolted rap anchor at top of pitch; 'top of upper slab' overstated since easy gear-protected ground follows
3.text: Bolted rappel anchor at the top of the pitch; the rappel back to the pitch 2 anchor is not plumb and angles toward the gully.
